xml.name: write_config
xml.configfile:
import configparser import sys
source, target, *pairs = sys.argv[1:] config = configparser.RawConfigParser(inline_comment_prefixes=None) config.optionxform = str config.read(source, encoding="utf-8") for pair in pairs: key, value = pair.split("=", 1) section, option = key.split(".", 1) if not config.has_section(section): config.add_section(section) config.set(section, option, value) with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle: config.write(handle)

param.name: document
param.label: OCR output or text-bearing document
param.help: One document per job: an ALTO file (one or many pages), OCR JSON, or a text-bearing file (plain text, CSV or TSV with a text column, hOCR, PAGE XML, Tesseract TSV, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, Markdown). For a collection, the tool runs once per document; the element name becomes the document id.

param.name: kind
param.label: Reading method
param.option: Text lines: any of the formats above, ALTO included; writes the line table
ALTO: page texts in alto-tools reading order, and one ALTO file per page
OCR JSON: page texts from the JSON's text fields

param.name: strict
param.label: Fail when the document cannot be read
param.help: Otherwise an empty, unreadable or image-only file is reported in the pages report and skipped.

param.name: baseline
param.label: Document record to add to
param.help: An ATRIUM document record from an earlier stage; this stage's blocks are added to it.
